{{Short description|French physicist and inventor}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=September 2020}}

[[File:Jacques Lewiner (1998).jpg|thumb|right|Lewiner in 1998]]

'''Jacques Lewiner''' (born in 1943) is a French physicist and inventor. He is professor and Honorary Scientific Director of [[École supérieure de physique et de chimie industrielles de la ville de Paris]] (ESPCI Paris), and (since 2012) dean of innovation and entrepreneurship at [[PSL Research University]].

Jacques Lewiner has carried out basic and applied research in various domains of physics.<ref>[http://jacques.lewiner.org Jacques Lewiner's Homepage]</ref> Following his PhD, he taught at [[Catholic University of America]] and specialized in the study of the electrical properties of solid matter. Back in France he was nominated Professor in charge of the Electromagnetism Chair<ref>[http://www.leg.espci.fr/recherches/recherches.htm Laboratoire d'électricité générale de l'ESPCI Paris] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090720211823/http://www.leg.espci.fr/recherches/recherches.htm |date=20 July 2009 }}</ref> at ESPCI Paris where [[Georges Charpak]] arrived in 1980. From 1987 to 2001 he was [[Academic ranks in France|''directeur d'études'']] at ESPCI Paris under the direction of [[Pierre-Gilles de Gennes]].

Lewiner's works have been devoted to electrical insulators and particularly [[electret]]s, instrumentation and sensors, for instance in medical imaging, or on the improvement of telecommunication networks.

Jacques Lewiner has filed a large number of patent applications leading to industrial development, either through licenses granted to industrial companies or through start-up companies often created with former students or researchers. He has participated in the creation of various technology oriented start up companies, for instance Inventel, specializing in Telecommunications, Finsécur<ref>[http://www.finsecur.com/index.html Finsécur] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090329031550/http://www.finsecur.com/index.html |date=29 March 2009 }}</ref> which develops and markets fire detection systems, [[Sculpteo]] which is an online [[3D printing]] platform, Roowin<ref>[http://www.roowin.com/index.php Roowin] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081112094442/http://www.roowin.com/index.php |date=12 November 2008 }}</ref> in the field of chemical synthesis and Cynove in embedded electronics devices. Most of these companies have experienced a strong growth. For instance [[Inventel]], which was the French leader for multimedia gateways was bought by [[Thomson SA]] in 2005.<ref>[http://www.accessmylibrary.com/coms2/summary_0286-9073284_ITM Thomson bought Inventel]</ref> With [[Jean-Louis Viovy]] he created Fluigent<ref>[http://www.fluigent.com Fluigent]</ref> which develops fluid motion systems for micro-fluidic applications.

Jacques Lewiner is laureate of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] in 1990, Knight in the [[National Order of the Legion of Honor]], member of the [[French Academy of Technologies]]<ref>[http://www.academie-technologies.fr/membres/membresWhosWhoDetail.php?user=334 Académie des Technologies] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081114003107/http://academie-technologies.fr/membres/membresWhosWhoDetail.php?user=334 |date=14 November 2008 }}</ref> since 2005, Honorary Fellow of the [[Technion]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.focus.technion.ac.il/Nov08/technionHeadlinesStory1.htm |title=Technion |access-date=27 March 2009 |archive-date=18 February 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100218151645/http://www.focus.technion.ac.il/Nov08/technionHeadlinesStory1.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref> Doctor Honoris Causa from [[Ben Gurion University of the Negev]],<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LgpTv8GCFyo Conferment Ceremony of Honorary Doctoral Degrees at BGU - Prof. Jacques Lewiner]</ref> Doctor Honoris Causa from [[Technion]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.technion.ac.il/en/2016/06/technion-honorary-doctorates-2016/ |title=Technion Honorary Doctorates 2016 |access-date=10 December 2017 |archive-date=11 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171211110341/http://www.technion.ac.il/en/2016/06/technion-honorary-doctorates-2016/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2017 he has received the [[Marius Lavet]] Special Prize.<ref>[http://lavet.fr/xviedition/ XVIeme edition du Prix Marius Lavet]</ref>

In 1968 he married Colette de Botton (who received her doctorate in physics in 1973 and has won several awards). They have three children.<ref>{{cite web|title=Colette's Lewiner's Homepage|url=http://colette.lewiner.org/colette-lewiner.html}}</ref> In 2005 Jacques and Colette Lewiner gave a large endowment to the [[Technion]]'s Institute for Theoretical Physics, and in June 2006 a naming ceremony established the [[Lewiner Institute for Theoretical Physics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.israelphysicalsociety.org/content/lewiner-institute-theoretical-physics|title=The Lewiner Institute for Theoretical Physics &#124; Israel Physical Society|access-date=8 July 2022|archive-date=8 July 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220708071231/https://www.israelphysicalsociety.org/content/lewiner-institute-theoretical-physics|url-status=dead}}</ref>
